gente.linea: Work backwards from the customer; write the six-pager before the meeting; be stubborn on the vision and flexible on the details.
Say no to a thousand things; the product is the whole experience, not the feature; taste is what you remove.
Sell direct, build to order, keep inventory near zero — the model is the moat, not the machine.
Question every requirement, delete the part, then simplify; the best process is no process.
Talk in terms of the other person's interests; remember the name; let them save face.
Mastery takes a long apprenticeship; read power as it is, not as you wish it were.
Start with why; the infinite game is played to keep playing, not to win.
Bring AI to every task and see where it fails; the centaur and the cyborg are two ways to work with it.
Callous the mind; the 40% rule; nobody is coming to save you.
State, story, strategy — in that order; change the question and you change the answer.
The company is a community of persons; a boss serves first; sanctity is possible in a factory.
Between stimulus and response there is a space; meaning is found in work, love and suffering borne well.
Virtue is a habit; the mean between excess and defect; happiness is activity in accordance with excellence.
You have power over your mind, not outside events; do the thing in front of you.
Humility is thinking of yourself less; the longing points to something beyond this world.
Interior freedom grows in acceptance; peace of heart is the condition for doing good, not its reward.
Ask the one the decision lands on; technology must serve the dignity of the person and the common good.
